article.content: The Orlando City product scored his first goal in La Liga, playing three positions in a comeback win over Valencia While most of La Liga’s oxygen was consumed by the first el clásico since José Mourinho’s return to Real Madrid this weekend, another rivalry put Alex Freeman in the spotlight position.
